metadata.source: New York State ZIP Codes-County FIPS Cross-Reference
metadata.caveat: EVERY ROW IN THE SOURCE IS DATED 2007-07-25 AND THE DATASET HAS NEVER BEEN REVISED. Use it to mark a ZIP as KNOWN-AMBIGUOUS, never to assert a county with confidence. It UNDER-DETECTS: a ZIP listed here as spanning two counties almost certainly still does, but one listed as clean may have become ambiguous since 2007 and would be missed. Under-detection is the unsafe direction, which is why an explicit customer.tax_county overrides it and why resolution refuses rather than guesses.
metadata.county_naming: Counties carry the PLATFORM's spelling so they join us-county-tax-rates.json and platform_tax_rates.county. The state prints 'St. Lawrence'; every platform file uses 'St Lawrence'.
